## MedplumClient.bulkExport() method

Performs Bulk Data Export operation request flow. See the [FHIR "Bulk Data Export"](https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/bulk-data/export.html#bulk-data-export) for full details.

**Signature:**

```typescript
bulkExport(exportLevel?: string, resourceTypes?: string, since?: string, options?: MedplumRequestOptions): Promise<Partial<BulkDataExport>>;
```
